title: inconsistent leads → automate system, using Metricool
caption:
inconsistent leads → automate system, using Metricool

The exact stack behind this:
1️⃣ Load the whole week — One sitting, seven posts — planning done until Monday morning, no daily tab juggle.
2️⃣ Let auto-slot pick — Best time per network, chosen from your audience's actual activity — not generic advice.
3️⃣ Compare per post — Reach and engagement per post — vanity totals hide which idea is actually working.
4️⃣ Reshare the top 10% — Monthly: winners repost, losers retire. Old reach compounds instead of expiring in a feed.
